summary.en: An exhibit is laid on the mat, the rest of the page veiled, its printed claim struck with the highlighter and tied to its sticker; the claim rises on the mat, the terms under it.
summary.zh: 一份证物放上垫板，页面其余部分压暗，印出的断言被荧光笔划出并用引线连到贴纸；断言在垫板上升起，条件跟在下面。

fits: Each published source of a claim: the cold open, every new exhibit.
notFor: claims with no printed source; pages whose claim cannot be struck where it is.

intent.en: Show the claim where it was printed and strike it, so the viewer sees the evidence before the words.
intent.zh: 在印出断言的原处把它划出来，让观众先看到证据再看到话。

content.en: A captured page, the box of its printed claim (image px), the claim (≤ 8 words) and its terms.
content.zh: 一张截图页面，断言印出位置的框（图像像素），断言（≤ 20 字）和条件。

fits.zh: 一条断言的每一个发布出处：冷开场、每一份新证物。

notFor.zh: 没有印刷出处的断言；断言无法在原处划出的页面。

pairs.note: the next claim on the same page

en: Strike only what the page prints; a number the page does not print goes to the worksheet.
One band lit at a time.
zh: 只划页面上印着的；页面没印的数字放到演算纸上算。

source.path: the dossier source film planOf exhibit; film.js paintSheet, buildMat, paintHeader, dealY

overlaps.note: the exhibit style's spotlight on an asset (veil and ring); here the claim is struck in multiply and tied to a sticker
a marker under a title in type; here the stroke is over a captured page

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
